work_item: B04 keyed comparison of two supplied CSV tables with two-sided original source locations through Core
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

tests_and_route.reason_not_executed: No tests or runtime/ordinary CLI verification were requested or run in this implementation slice; formatting, compilation, lint and build checks only were run.

implemented_route: apps/cli -> Core::run -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::CsvCompare -> document::csv_compare_by -> DocumentResult artifact
input_contract: One explicit headered CSV body per side. After the operation header, body syntax is exactly --- MINIDORA LEFT CSV --- LF <left CSV> CRLF --- MINIDORA RIGHT CSV --- LF <right CSV>. Marker text is reserved and forbidden inside either payload.
supported_behavior: The operation requires both tables to parse as valid headered CSV and their decoded header names to match in the same order.
The selected named key column must exist and contain unique exact decoded string values within each table; no numeric conversion, trimming, case folding or Unicode normalization is performed.
Rows are matched by exact key. The report contains per-cell changes, full added/removed rows, stable left-row/column ordering followed by right-side additions, and counts in result parameters.

Output value spans identify the exact original bytes for each emitted key, header, cell and row value; changed cells retain source locations on both input sides. Spans reference the complete comparison body including reserved markers.
Malformed CSV, missing columns, duplicate keys, mismatched schemas, ambiguous marker syntax, and input/output bound violations stop with typed failures.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; source implementation and format/check/lint/build evidence only, no test or ordinary-route execution
